sections.title: OUR ROOTS
paragraphs: Our story begins in the cobble stoned streets of a Sicilian patisserie, where the Vigneri family first fell in love with the art of confection.
In the scent of warm pastries and the flicker of old ovens, a legacy of sweetness began to rise.
With hands guided by tradition and hearts full of dreams, the Vigneri name became known for its devotion to the craft.

items.title: VISION
items.text: Our vision is to be an industry leading chocolate brand known for craftsmanship, creativity, and care while building a farmers-first, sustainable future through ethical sourcing and responsible practices.

items.title: FOCUS
items.text: Our focus is to combine passionate people, innovative craft, and sustainable practices to create chocolate with purpose and care.

items.title: MISSION
items.text: We passionately handcraft the highest-quality chocolates and deliver the sweetest, most memorable experiences to our customers.

sections.title: Our Values
paragraphs: Our values are the key ingredients in our chocolate and in everything we do:

items.title: Integrity
items.text: We stand by our promise of quality, care, and food safety in every step.

items.title: Inspire
items.text: We bring passion to our craft and encourage fresh ideas every day.

items.title: Ingredients
items.text: We choose the purest, most sustainable ingredients to create with purpose.

items.title: Innovation
items.text: We think ahead and push boundaries to craft the future.

items.title: Invest
items.text: We grow by investing in our people, our partners, and our community.

We always meet the highest standards of quality and food safety so you can taste and trust every bite.

sections.title: Focus
paragraphs: At DeCocoa Chocolate Crafters, our focus is to combine passionate people, innovative craft, and sustainable practices to create chocolate with purpose and care.

sections.title: Sustainability
paragraphs: We are committed to making chocolate that’s better for people and the planet. From responsible sourcing to eco-friendly packaging, we craft our chocolate using 100% sustainable power harnessed from the mighty energy of The Niagara Falls, leaving a lighter footprint on our Planet Earth.

sections.title: Food Safety
paragraphs: We are committed to producing safe, high-quality, and authentic products that meet or exceed customer expectations.
We ensure:
bullets: Full compliance with all food safety laws and regulations, including adherence to the highest level of SQF food safety quality standards
Clear communication with employees, partners, suppliers, customers, and regulators
Ongoing training to empower our team and strengthen our Food Safety Culture
Continuous improvement in our processes, products, and services

ordered_steps.title: Picking
ordered_steps.text: Ripe cocoa pods are cut by hand. Only ready pods are chosen. The tree is protected.

ordered_steps.title: Harversting
ordered_steps.text: Pods are gathered and carried from the field. Freshness matters. Flavor starts now.

ordered_steps.title: Fermentation
ordered_steps.text: Beans are removed and left to ferment. Heat builds. Flavor develops.

ordered_steps.title: Drying
ordered_steps.text: Beans dry in the sun. Moisture fades. The flavor settles.

ordered_steps.title: Roasting
ordered_steps.text: Heat unlocks cocoa flavor.Aromas deepen. Character forms.

ordered_steps.title: Griding and Coaching
ordered_steps.text: Beans become chocolate. Time creates smooth texture. Flavor finds balance.

ordered_steps.title: Tempering
ordered_steps.text: Chocolate is heated and cooled. It gains shine and snap. Ready to enjoy.
